intro: Romania is a semi-presidential republic and a member of the EU and NATO.

chapters.title: President and parliament
text: The president is directly elected for five years and shares power with a prime minister, who needs the support of the two-chamber parliament. In 2024 a presidential election was cancelled over evidence of foreign interference; the re-run in 2025 was won by Nicușor Dan, the mayor of Bucharest.
Romania has 41 counties plus Bucharest and uses its own currency, the leu. The flag has vertical blue, yellow and red stripes.

chapters.title: Romania in the world
text: Romania joined NATO in 2004 and the EU in 2007. Its position on the Black Sea next to Ukraine has made it important to NATO's defence since 2022.

keyTerms.meaning: A system where an elected president and a prime minister share power.
